tests.name: test_h01_truncate_preserves_text_at_the_maximum_length
tests.hint: Check what happens when the text is exactly the maximum length.

tests.name: test_h02_truncate_counts_unicode_characters_rather_than_utf_16_units
tests.hint: Count user-perceived characters rather than storage units.

tests.name: test_h03_slugify_normalises_accented_letters
tests.hint: Consider how letters with marks should appear in a URL label.

tests.name: test_h04_slugify_collapses_punctuation_and_whitespace
tests.hint: Ensure runs of separators produce one clean separator.

tests.name: test_h05_title_case_capitalises_hyphenated_words
tests.hint: Treat punctuation that joins words as a word boundary when appropriate.

tests.name: test_h06_word_count_returns_zero_for_empty_text
tests.hint: Decide what an input with no words should return.

tests.name: test_h07_word_count_accepts_mixed_whitespace
tests.hint: Do not assume that every separator is an ordinary space.

tests.name: test_h08_reverse_words_normalises_repeated_whitespace
tests.hint: Define the output spacing after separating the words.

tests.name: test_h09_is_palindrome_ignores_case_and_punctuation
tests.hint: Compare the meaningful characters, not the presentation characters.

tests.name: test_h10_is_palindrome_rejects_a_non_palindrome
tests.hint: Make sure the comparison can return False as well as True.
